data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Ballias', meaning 'tender, little, or protector'. Balliett can be translated as 'little warrior'. This name was given to babies born into noble families or those who were expected to protect and serve. The name Balliett carries the meaning “Little warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Balliett usually hope their child will grow to embody little warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
